body:
New 'Play GFD Battlegrounds' section on tournaments.html (WOTAN) linking to /battlegrounds/battlegrounds.html, the real WASM build (GoblinFoxDragon commit 36bfff0). Also: nginx /gfd-ws/<port> wss proxy config written (real TLS termination, bounded port capture matching the relay's own range, not an open proxy), following OKEMILY/CLAUDE.md's own documented protocol -- diffed against the live server file first, found and folded in real drift (prompt-o-verse no-cache block applied live but never synced to this repo), added the new block on top rather than the other way around. okemily-deploy.sh updated to exclude battlegrounds/ (same pattern as blog/tyler/prompt-o-verse -- its source of truth is the WASM build output, not this repo) before running the deploy, avoiding a repeat of the 2026-07-19 blog-wipe incident. Deployed and verified live: tournaments.html confirmed serving the new section at https://okemily.com/tournaments.html. nginx config itself queued (sudo-queue/18-gfd-web-websocket-proxy.sh) not yet applied -- needs founder sudo. Commits f7eb86f, 51f9bc6.

⚓ ☃
title: WOTAN links to the live GFD Battlegrounds web client
